blocks.text: LIGHTSPEED wireless and low-lag Bluetooth connectivity let you play and talk on PC, Mac, PS5/PS4, smartphones and other Bluetooth audio-enabled devices. Gaming-grade sound, carefully balanced high-fidelity audio, 40 mm audio drivers and compatibility with Dolby Atmos and Windows Sonic provide ultimate surround sound for all of your gaming adventures. With dual beamforming mics to reduce background noise without a mic arm. Plus, G435 is available in multiple colorways so you can match your favorite style to your gaming setup.

items.label: Versatile
items.value: Logitech G435 is the first headset with LIGHTSPEED wireless and low latency Bluetooth connectivity, providing more freedom of play on PC, Mac, smartphones, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch/Switch 2 gaming devices

items.label: Lightweight
items.value: With a lightweight construction, this wireless gaming headset weighs only 5.8 oz (165 g), making it comfortable to wear all day long

items.label: Superior voice quality
items.value: Be heard loud and clear thanks to the built-in dual beamforming microphones that eliminate the need for a mic arm and reduce background noise

items.label: Immersive sound
items.value: This cool and colorful headset delivers carefully balanced, high-fidelity audio with 40 mm drivers; compatibility with Dolby Atmos, Tempest 3D AudioTech and Windows Sonic for a true surround sound experience

items.label: Long battery life
items.value: No need to stop the game to recharge thanks to G435's 18 hours of battery life, allowing you to keep playing, talking to friends, and listening to music all day

items.label: Total comfort
items.value: G435 small gaming headset fits a wide range of people but is designed for younger players with memory foam ear cushions and sizing for smaller head sizes

items: Plastic parts in G435 include 22% certified post consumer recycled plastic. Uses FSC-certified paper for responsible packaging.

items.label: Safer
items.value: An optional max volume limiter at less than 85 decibel can be activated to protect eardrums during extended use

items: The Logitech G435 Headset does not work seamlessly with Xbox Consoles. It is optimized for PC, Mac, smartphones, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch gaming devices

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: G435 Headset, LIGHTSPEED wireless USB-A receiver, USB-C to USB-A charging cable, User Documentation

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: PC with window® 10 or later, macOS® X 10.14 or later, PlayStation® 5, or PlayStation® 4, Bluetooth®: Nintendo Switch/Switch 2 and devices with Bluetooth audio connectivity
